reply:
That's a reasonable order to do it in — and it means the Sunday call has something behind it besides a scare.

One thing to hold loosely: the retest might not come back with a clean answer. It might come back as a number, a referral, a follow-up in a few weeks. So what you'd be handing Rubén may not be reassurance — it may just be a shape instead of a guess. Which is still more than he has now.

You've been up since four running arithmetic. You've got a number, a plan for the form, and a plan for your brother. That's not nothing to take to bed.
